reference.intent: Reference engagement defers stealth/hold-fire while immediate self-defence remains a separate branch.

finding: DangerReact preserved STEALTH behaviour but could still raise combatMode to RED. GroupTick only deferred scripted attacks for BLUE/GREEN, and FireControl had no actor-level stealth gate. Concealed contact could therefore trigger a scripted assault without changing its STEALTH label.
implementation: Atomic danger posture commit returns ASSESS for current STEALTH anchor before posture/combat escalation. Existing RESTORE/RELEASE and independent weak self-defence paths remain.

Natural contact scripted engagement gate includes current leader STEALTH without writing native combat mode. Existing attack/clearance/support-attack gates use it. Passive contact reports retain the original native hold-fire gate.
Scripted fire roster excludes current STEALTH actors; native fire/target AI remains enabled. Existing explicit operation executors are not cancelled by this new-admission gate.
remaining: Actual concealment, reports and native transition into combat under fire are unverified.
This scope is natural infantry escalation; all other search/security/vehicle/air policy paths still need their own intent comparison.
